Help.Text:
■ Opening the menu
   - Empty cell: right-click anywhere
   - Cell with a window: right-click the cell border, or Ctrl+right-click inside the cell

■ Adding windows
   - Drag another window by its title bar and drop it on a cell
   - Menu → Assign running window / Launch program
   - Drop a program file on an empty cell

■ Split / add tabs
   Ctrl+click a menu item to enter the number of panes (tabs).
   Arrange multiple programs: place several windows/programs as tabs, side by side or stacked at once

■ Shortcuts (while this window is active)
   F11 full screen · Ctrl+Alt+1~9 switch set · Ctrl+Alt+Z maximize cell
   In full screen, rest the mouse on the left/right screen edge for the previous/next set

■ Sets
   Switch, add, rename and delete sets from the set bar at the top or Menu → Sets
   Layout and assignments are saved automatically. On restart, only windows of the same programs that are already running
   are reattached to their cells (programs are never launched automatically).

■ Language
   Change it in View → Language. Put a language file (*.json) in the Languages folder next to the program to add a language.

See '사용법.md' (Korean user guide) for details.
